advice.good: Ingozi ya moya ni nziza. Shakira ibikorwa hanze!
advice.moderate: Hagati y'ubwiza. Abantu bumva bagomba kwirinda igihe kirekire.
advice.sensitive: Bidakwiye ku matsinda yumva. Ambara agakintu nibura.
advice.unhealthy: Ingozi ya moya yarenze. Gabanya ibikorwa hanze.
insight.good: Sukura ikirere cyiza kubera gukwirakwiza umuyaga mwiza. Umutekano kubikorwa byose.
insight.moderate: Kwiyubaka gato. Ibintu biremewe kubantu benshi.

insight.unhealthy: Umutekano muke wagaragaye. Tanga ibitekerezo byaho bitwikwa.
insight.hazardous: Ubwiza bw’ikirere bubi. Guma mu nzu kandi ukoreshe akayunguruzo niba bishoboka.
about.title: Ibyerekeye Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI igereranya PM2.5 buri munsi mu bihugu 54 bya Afrika.
about.overview.problem_desc: Imijyi myinshi ya Afrika nta bikoresho bireba ingozi ya moya. Turahaza iki cyuho.
about.how.intro: Gukoresha amakuru ya satelite na machine learning.
about.how.step1.title: Satelite nk'ibikoresho
about.how.step1.desc: Gukoresha amakuru ya ESA Sentinel-5P na NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Gukosora ku butaka
about.how.step2.desc: Modeli yatoje ku vituo 398 vyo gukurikirana mu bihugu 29.
about.how.step3.title: Gusesengura kwa continent
about.how.step3.desc: Modeli ya XGBoost iteganya PM2.5 ku cyimbo cyose cya Afrika.
about.limit.cloud_desc: Satelite ntishobora kubona mu bicu byinshi.
about.limit.gap_desc: Kujya kwa satelite buri munsi bishobora kubura ibyuka by'umwotsi ngufi.
about.who.citizens_desc: Reba ingozi ya moya mbere y'ibikorwa hanze.
